question: For independently reviewed GitHub Actions release decisions, does assignment to a model-authored EAL/2 argument executed through the EAL MCP server improve a correct, evidence-supported and faithfully communicated recommendation over strong prose at equal access and resource ceilings?

hypotheses.bounded_primary: In the frozen named-model and real-case population, the end-to-end E arm improves correct bounded decisions over P by at least the independently justified practical margin without breaching false-support or actionable-coverage limits.
hypotheses.represented_strata: The practical gain and safety/coverage conditions hold in every prespecified represented size/reasoning stratum; simultaneous inference is required.
hypotheses.universal_all_models: A finite enrolled model matrix cannot establish superiority for every existing or future language model class.
rivals: Explicit Toulmin prompting accounts for the effect without EAL/2.
A meaning-equivalent JSON form checked through the same MCP backend accounts for the effect without EAL/2 textual notation.
Host enforcement improves displayed status while source authoring, evidence collection or explanation still fails.
The effect depends on model snapshot, size, reasoning training, tool access, case family or budget.

scope.decision: Whether a particular commit satisfies the GitHub Actions release rule at a specified decision time.
scope.example_request: Before releasing commit {commit_sha} in {repository} at {decision_cut}, determine whether the required test workflow on that exact commit completed successfully and every required job in the effective release rule passed in the relevant attempt. Read the pinned workflow/rule and permitted run/attempt/job records; recommend proceed, wait or investigate with exact record IDs and limits.
scope.case_source: Genuine consented repository and CI decisions with an independently recoverable decision-time record; synthetic smoke fixtures and exposed prior cases are excluded from confirmation.
scope.family_definition: Shared repository/workflow lineage, release rule, incident, decision event or transformed variant; all repeated attempts and variants remain in one family.

stages.purpose: Calibrate real tool execution, independent reference, checker parity, scoring, model access, budgets and family-level variance.
Lock unseen case families, model snapshots, exact prompts and MCP schemas, grants, acquisition modes, margins, sample-size simulation, randomisation, analysis and stopping before outcomes.
Actually execute pinned Git reads and authenticated historical CI reads at an enforced decision-time cut on held-out cases.
Run later read-only decisions with live permitted acquisition, hidden from the actual operator, and report a separate estimate.

acquisition_modes.equal_access: Same case-specific grants, factual horizon, methods and resource ceilings; independent selected calls and failures remain in each attempt.
acquisition_modes.real_tool_contract: Reviewed, case-allowlisted read-only tools.toml command bindings execute pinned Git reads and authenticated CI GET; retrospective CI requires a genuine historical snapshot, not the example's live-only collector. Retain arguments, tool/version, raw response digest, source identity, timing and errors.
acquisition_modes.J_equivalence_gate: The eal2-ci-json-frontend/1 encoding covers the direct-declaration EAL/2 subset used by both E and J; JSON-to-source conversion supplies no omitted fields and differential tests show identical typed meaning and checked outcomes on valid and adversarial cases.
acquisition_modes.model_interaction: Two model requests: P/T first select calls, E first authors source/claim, J first authors program/claim; host executes permitted tools and MCP for E/J; second model request communicates decision from actual returned records.

independent_reference.review: Two masked domain engineers assess decision-time evidence; third adjudicates disputes; provenance reviewer checks source identity and time cut.

model_matrix.small: At least two named models with published active parameter count below a frozen small boundary.
model_matrix.large: At least two named models with published active parameter count above a frozen large boundary.
model_matrix.reasoning_axis: If available, at least two reasoning-optimised and two general instruction snapshots per size stratum; source and membership frozen.
model_matrix.undisclosed_size: Hosted models with undisclosed active parameters are reported separately and never assigned size from price or reputation.
model_matrix.failed_coverage_rule: Narrow claims to enrolled named snapshots and represented strata.

assignment.randomisation: Counterbalance P/T/J/E order within case-by-model blocks using a frozen seed and fresh contexts.
assignment.one_attempt_ledger: Durable assignment start before any call; terminal outcome or visibly interrupted assignment; no replacement after authoring, tool, provider or MCP failure.

outcomes.primary_Y: Correct relevant claim/family and permissible action using admissible exact-commit decision-time evidence and rule/query, with accurate status, grounds, objection and qualification in the final answer. All required components must pass per assigned attempt.
outcomes.false_support_F: Affirmative proceed when independently bounded reference does not justify it, over every assigned adverse or indeterminate attempt.
outcomes.actionable_coverage: Decision coverage among cases where the independent reference finds an adequate basis to act; indiscriminate refusal cannot satisfy the safety gate.
outcomes.raw_and_host_owned_display: Separate and retained for communication scoring.

analysis.primary_estimand: Family-weighted paired ITT risk difference E minus P in selected-acquisition held-out retrospective cases, equal frozen named-model weights.
analysis.shadow_estimand: Same prespecified contrast on later prospective shadow cases, reported separately.
analysis.inference: Paired family-cluster uncertainty; named-model effects and simultaneous intervals for prespecified strata, retaining within-family variants and attempts.
analysis.inconclusive: Intervals overlapping material benefit and harm, incompatible model effects, failed measurement/parity or insufficient cases do not support the bounded claim.
